part.title: Inside the Real vLLM
part.readme_note: Lessons 3.1–3.5 include pinned-source reading, CPU experiments, and exercises. Lesson 3.4 compares v0.8.5 and v0.17.1; the other main paths use v0.8.5. State, tensor, and configuration exercises do not validate GPU execution.

3.1.title: A request's journey through vLLM
3.1.topics: Pinned v0.8.5 request path; inputs, processes/threads/tasks, message structures, model iterations, output merging, and cancellation cleanup

3.2.title: Scheduling and KV management in vLLM
3.2.topics: Pinned v0.8.5; token gaps and budgets, mixed scheduling, block allocation, prefix references, head-of-line blocking, recompute preemption, and execution feedback

3.3.title: Model execution and attention backends
3.3.topics: Pinned v0.8.5; model loading, weight orientation and fused QKV, input packing, RoPE/GQA, attention metadata, backend contracts, and candidate filtering

3.4.title: V1 and ModelRunner evolution
3.4.topics: V0/V1 vs. MRV1/MRV2; stable slots, staged writes, copy lifetime, GPU metadata, sampling math, and graph dispatch

3.5.title: Resolving configuration and capabilities
3.5.topics: CLI/SDK to EngineArgs; None vs. False, V1 defaults and policy overrides, value provenance, budget constraints, and platform/runtime validation
